headline: Rally Co-Driver goes online
lede: The night rally gets its second seat for real: open a room, hand a friend the code, and co-drive the same stage from two phones — pace notes over the relay, lockstep hashes keeping both cars honest.

notes.text: Online lobby shipped (#1448): host curates stage + weather and kicks; the guest plays the co-driver seat only — QWE/ASD/Z keys on a keyboard, arrow-taps with A/B severity modifiers on a phone.

The dead session had the protocol proven but the waiting room never mounted — correct code nobody could play. The harness grew a static shell audit (tier 8) that pins the exact wires: overlay mounted, socket closed, guest pad mapped, kick wired. Its mutant reddens the walkaway law.
Two #1448 gaps were already shipped and are closed with evidence (checkpoint clock #1438, reflector posts #1427); the recorder-backed VU bar stays on the board for the QA lane.
SEEDPIN batches 5-7 landed while this shift ran — Emberwood, ViperPit, CivV, Myst, BardsTale, PickRush, FourHalls, IronKeep and more now report and honor ?seed=N.
